title: F3B-2 Historical Word Pilot and Activities Evidence Review Dossier
evidence_boundaries: Historical source pointers and source-reference review are not word-level evidence or production approval.

F3B-2 contains no authenticated lexical entries. F3B-3 hosted-entry observations are recorded separately below; no original dictionary edition or scriptural attestation has been independently authenticated.
Proposed lookup forms and IAST are unreviewed preparation, not established morphology or approved transliteration.
Original editorial definitions remain editorial copy and are not dictionary-grounded lexical meanings.
Pending slots instantiate existing AG69H and AG70E review fields but are not attached production evidence records.
No AG63/D02 rotation, D04 selection or AG70D runtime is activated; no generated output or homepage consumes this dossier.
Missing AG69I/J artifacts are not recreated. The surviving AG69F queue and current v2 contracts are used directly.

pending_evidence_template.reviewer_note: Pending capture slot only. No entry-level lookup or language review has been performed.
capture_requirements: Identify a specific dictionary and edition, not only a collection or portal homepage.
Record author/editor, publisher, exact headword and a stable entry, page/column or scan locator.
Record the entry URL where available; otherwise retain a precise bibliographic locator.
Record the actual access date and evidence language only after examining the entry.
Record the supported sense and its limits separately from Drishvara editorial reflections.
Check citation/reuse restrictions and use bounded evidence notes, never bulk dictionary text.
Attach an evidence ID and reviewer decision only after actual capture; access alone is not approval.

word_qualification_gaps: Exact Sanskrit and Hindi lexical evidence, entry locators and linked source/evidence IDs.
Reviewed script, IAST, lemma/stem versus inflected form and morphology where applicable.
Supported bilingual semantics, semantic range, usage boundary and separately reviewed reflective sense.
Explicit etymology status; no fabricated root, derivation or historical claim.
Source access/reuse, internal textual discipline, linguistic, safety and editorial reviews.
Public-use and approved-bank gates remain unmet; research eligibility is not output eligibility.
Future date/context assignment, reviewed context matching, duplicate/history checks and output connector approval remain separate gates.

bibliographic_observations.scope: Bibliographic and rights metadata only, not a dhairya entry lookup.

reflection.classification_support: Two separately attributed dictionary blocks report a neuter noun for the selected cognitive senses; both are hosted on Wisdom Library.
reflection.recorded_form_relationship: The lookup stem and historical mananam remain separate. A neuter nominal-form relationship is proposed, but inflection, case and number are still subject to morphology review.
reflection.sense_boundary: The historical sustained inward consideration before response wording remains an editorial reflection, not a dictionary quotation. Do not merge manana with mānana or other variants distinguished by long vowels or different scripts.

discernment.classification_support: The inspected dictionary blocks report a masculine noun; Klryz prints a divided headword while Wisdom Library prints the undivided lookup form.
discernment.recorded_form_relationship: Retain historical विवेकः and proposed IAST vivekaḥ; the possible nominative-singular relationship is an inference pending morphology review.
discernment.sense_boundary: General discrimination/judgment senses do not authorize a universal Vedanta interpretation or the historical signal-versus-distraction definition as a dictionary quotation.

patience.classification_support: The MW block reports a neuter noun; the Apte-attributed block separately supplies numbered senses and the displayed derivable form.
patience.recorded_form_relationship: Keep dhairya and historical dhairyam distinct; the neuter nominal-form relationship, including case/number, remains pending. The blocked SanskritDictionary result supplies no support.
patience.sense_boundary: Firmness, affective composure and patience are different lexical senses, not a single interchangeable psychological claim or a verification of the historical editorial sentence.

remaining_reviews: Register or qualify the actually inspected third-party sources before any production evidence attachment; parent Cologne/DSAL registrations are attribution links, not proof those original entries were inspected.
Compare exact dictionary entries with an identified original edition/scan; Cologne MW/CAE links opened only index shells, not word-level primary evidence.
Complete Sanskrit morphology, case/number, IAST and Hindi lexical/translation reviews independently.
Keep etymology, textual attestations and contextual/reflection claims pending; no roots or scriptural quotations are approved.
Review reuse/licensing and bilingual safety/editorial suitability before any public-use decision.
All AG70D selection, duplicate/history and output-connector gates remain separate and closed.

output_fields.avoidance_note_en: Avoid hurried decisions and unnecessary confrontation.
